definitions.explanation: A sour liquid made through fermentation, used as a condiment and in cooking. Essential for sushi rice.

examples.japanese: ⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{酢|す}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけます→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: I put vinegar on the salad.
It's said that vinegar is good for your health.

examples.japanese: {酢|す}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦さっぱりして→さっぱり：02777_sappari⟧⟦おいしい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Vinegared dishes are refreshing and delicious in summer.

examples.japanese: {酢|す}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜて→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧⟦タレ→タレ：10500_tare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}りました→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I mixed vinegar and soy sauce to make a dipping sauce.

notes:
{酢|す} (vinegar) is one of the basic seasonings in Japanese cooking.

TYPES OF VINEGAR:
- ⟦{米酢|こめず}→米酢：24254_komezu⟧: rice vinegar (most common in Japan)
- ⟦{穀物酢|こくもつす}→穀物酢：24495_kokumotsusu⟧: grain vinegar
- ⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧{酢|す}: apple cider vinegar
- ⟦{黒酢|くろず}→黒酢：17574_kurozu⟧: black vinegar
- ⟦{寿司酢|すしず}→寿司酢：24484_sushizu⟧: sushi vinegar (pre-seasoned)

IN COOKING:
- ⟦{酢飯|すめし}→酢飯：14460_sumeshi⟧: sushi rice (vinegar-seasoned)
- {酢|す}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧: vinegared dishes (cucumber, etc.)
- ⟦{甘酢|あまず}→甘酢：14851_amazu⟧: sweet vinegar
- {酢|す}⟦{漬|づ}け→漬け：noentry⟧: pickled in vinegar
- ⟦{南蛮漬|なんばんづ}け→南蛮漬け：27594_nanbanzuke⟧: fried fish in vinegar sauce

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {酢|す}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to put vinegar on
- {酢|す}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{和|あ}える→和える：05824_aeru⟧: to dress with vinegar
- {酢|す}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{漬|つ}ける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to pickle in vinegar

HEALTH BENEFITS:
{酢|す}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (Vinegar is good for health) is a common saying.
